lede: Courses taught by REACH Lab faculty at NYU Abu Dhabi.

courses.title: Mechatronics
courses.text: An undergraduate course on mechatronic systems, bringing mechanical design, sensing, actuation and embedded control together into working robotic and automated devices, taught by Fares Abu-Dakka.

courses.title: Space Robotics
courses.text: A PhD elective in the NYUAD Astrophysics and Space Systems programme, introducing the robotics and autonomous systems used in space exploration and operations.
